name: upsert_count_consistency
verification_script:
import requests,sys,uuid
BASE='{{TESTVDB_DB_URL}}'
c='bc_upsert_'+uuid.uuid4().hex[:8]
r=requests.put(f'{BASE}/collections/{c}',json={'vectors':{'size':4,'distance':'Cosine'}})
import time;time.sleep(0.5)
points=[{'id':i+1,'vector':[0.1*i,0.2*i,0.3*i,0.4*i]} for i in range(5)]
r=requests.put(f'{BASE}/collections/{c}/points',json={'points':points})
time.sleep(0.5)
info=requests.get(f'{BASE}/collections/{c}').json()
count=info.get('result',{}).get('points_count',-1)
if count!=5:print(f'[DEFECT: STATE_LOGIC_VIOLATION] upsert 5 points but count={count}');sys.exit(1)
else:print(f'count consistent: {count}');sys.exit(0)
expected_outcome: points_count == 5 after upserting 5 points

name: mut_scroll_pagination_completeness
verification_script:
import requests,sys,uuid,time
BASE='{{TESTVDB_DB_URL}}'
c='mut_scroll_full_'+uuid.uuid4().hex[:8]
r=requests.put(f'{BASE}/collections/{c}',json={'vectors':{'size':4,'distance':'Cosine'}})
time.sleep(0.5)
points=[{'id':i+1,'vector':[0.05*i,0.05*i,0.05*i,0.05*i]} for i in range(20)]
r=requests.put(f'{BASE}/collections/{c}/points',json={'points':points})
time.sleep(1.0)
for attempt in range(10):
    info=requests.get(f'{BASE}/collections/{c}').json()
    count=info.get('result',{}).get('points_count',0)
    if count>=20:break
    time.sleep(0.5)
all_ids=set()
next_page=None
for page in range(4):
    body={'limit':5,'with_payload':False,'with_vector':False}
    if next_page is not None:
        body['offset']=next_page
    r=requests.post(f'{BASE}/collections/{c}/points/scroll',json=body)
    data=r.json().get('result',{})
    if isinstance(data,dict):
        pts=data.get('points',[])
        next_page=data.get('next_page_offset',None)
    elif isinstance(data,list):
        pts=data
        next_page=None
    else:
        pts=[]
        next_page=None
    page_ids=set(p['id'] for p in pts)
    overlap=all_ids&page_ids
    if overlap:print(f'[DEFECT: STATE_LOGIC_VIOLATION] scroll page {page+1} has duplicate IDs: {overlap}');sys.exit(1)
    all_ids.update(page_ids)
if len(all_ids)!=20:print(f'[DEFECT: STATE_LOGIC_VIOLATION] scroll collected {len(all_ids)} unique IDs, expected 20');sys.exit(1)
print(f'scroll pagination complete: {len(all_ids)} unique IDs across 4 pages');sys.exit(0)
expected_outcome: scroll with limit=5 across 4 pages collects all 20 unique point IDs with no duplicates
